section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedures for a Portuguese study, which is part of a larger research project. Participants were recruited via online advertisements on social networks. The initial sample consisted of 514 individuals (494 women, 20 men) aged 17 to 57. For the current study's purpose, male participants and those outside the 18-55 age range were excluded.
section_summary.evidence_source: The present study is part of a wider Portuguese research... The sample was obtained through online advertisements on social networks... The initial sample was composed of 514 individuals (494 women and 20 men), with ages ranging from 17 to 57 years old. However, taking into account the purpose of the current study, data cleaning procedures excluded: (a) male participants and (b) participants younger than 18 years old and older than 55 years old.
